title: RWA Tokenized Asset Securities Jurisdiction Mapper
description: Maps tokenized real-world assets (RWA) to regulatory classifications across EU (MiCA/MiFID II), US (SEC/CFTC/GENIUS Act), UK (FCA PS19/22), UAE, and Singapore. Determines security, commodity, e-money, crypto-asset, or payment stablecoin classification and required pathways. Outputs AP2 mandate.
